notes: All 228 JPN rows are fixed ASCII item short names, internal IDs, equipment/ammunition codes, brand/collaboration labels, or costume codes; no JPN semantic prose or runtime controls are present.
cn_text therefore identity-preserves JPN text for every row.
Auxiliary version substitutions/mismatches such as AXE→COLOGNE, BON CURRY variants, LIOLAEUS→RATHALOS, BAD SMELL→STENCH, GIA-LIQ-* replacements, BOX SMOKE→SMOKE BOX, and M.RCV.→P.RCV. are rejected.
